testCases.description: Ingestion of mixed INR, USD, EUR, GBP transactions without unapproved aggregation
testCases.expectedBehavior: Isolate original currencies; compute converted INR using audited FX rate; no silent mixing
testCases.actualBehavior: Currencies preserved individually with conversion status CONVERTED_RBI_REFERENCE and zero mixing

testCases.description: Transactions with MT, KG, LITRE, PIECE, ROLL, BOX in single category
testCases.expectedBehavior: Flag incompatible UOMs as UOM_NOT_AGGREGABLE unless governed conversion formula exists
testCases.actualBehavior: Governed conversion applied only for MT->KG (1000x); discrete units remain unaggregated

testCases.description: Category with 15+ competing suppliers supplying identical items
testCases.expectedBehavior: Reconcile supplier spend upward to category total with zero unexplained variance
testCases.actualBehavior: Sum of individual supplier spends equals category spend exactly with variance INR 0.00

testCases.description: Customer transactions spanning Direct, Indirect, Capex, and MRO categories
testCases.expectedBehavior: Maintain hierarchical integrity: Supplier -> Category -> Subcategory -> Item
testCases.actualBehavior: 100% hierarchy preserved; zero orphans or disappeared transactions across tree

testCases.description: Single conglomerate supplier providing Fasteners, Electrical, and Packaging
testCases.expectedBehavior: Analyze each category separately; classify Core vs Non-Core; do not bundle arbitrarily
testCases.actualBehavior: Fasteners isolated as Core; Packaging flagged as Non-Core distributor with specialist option

testCases.description: 6 tail suppliers providing identical specification corrugated boxes
testCases.expectedBehavior: Evaluate volume bundling feasibility based on capacity, delivery SLA, and switching risk
testCases.actualBehavior: Feasibility confirmed; volume bundled to top 2 audited suppliers with risk mitigation

testCases.description: Identical PO, line item, invoice, date, quantity, and amount uploaded twice
testCases.expectedBehavior: Quarantine second record as DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION; exclude from commercial spend
testCases.actualBehavior: Exact duplicate quarantined with hash match; raw ledger preserved without double counting

testCases.description: Apparent price dispersion caused by grade differences (SS304 vs SS316)
testCases.expectedBehavior: Prevent false arbitrage calculation between distinct material specifications
testCases.actualBehavior: Specification clustering isolates SS304 from SS316; zero false price opportunity generated

testCases.description: Purchase row missing unit price, quantity, or supplier name
testCases.expectedBehavior: Quarantine row with structured reason code; require audit resolution before handoff
testCases.actualBehavior: Flagged with REASON_CODE=MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELDS; excluded from baseline calculation

testCases.description: Free sample or warranty replacement transactions with zero line value
testCases.expectedBehavior: Preserve record in raw audit trail; exclude from commercial weighted average calculation
testCases.actualBehavior: Classified as ZERO_VALUE_SAMPLE; audit trail preserved; excluded from price baseline

testCases.description: Credit notes, return debits, and volume rebates with negative values
testCases.expectedBehavior: Categorize as CREDIT_DEBIT_RETURN; apply to net supplier spend with reconciliation audit
testCases.actualBehavior: Credit notes audited and subtracted from net supplier ledger; gross and net reconciled

testCases.description: Wide price dispersion across spot buys with statistical outliers
testCases.expectedBehavior: Calculate P10, P25, Median, Weighted Avg, P75, P90, IQR; use lowest credible, never raw MIN
testCases.actualBehavior: Raw MIN rejected as unverified spot buy; Lowest Credible Historical Price selected at P15

testCases.description: Blend of contracted annual frame agreements and off-contract spot purchases
testCases.expectedBehavior: Segment contract spend from spot spend; target spot leakage for contract consolidation
testCases.actualBehavior: Contract compliance tagged at 78.4%; spot leakage isolated with volume pooling recommendation

testCases.description: Recurring monthly raw material purchases vs one-time capital tooling projects
testCases.expectedBehavior: Filter one-time capex from ongoing strategic sourcing baseline
testCases.actualBehavior: Tooling spend classified as NON_RECURRENT_CAPEX; excluded from recurring run-rate savings

testCases.description: Highly standardized commodity with 5 qualified vendors and high annual spend
testCases.expectedBehavior: Recommend reverse auction format; define reserve price logic; label as competitive potential
testCases.actualBehavior: E-Auction recommended; potential range ₹1.24 Cr - ₹1.86 Cr; labeled illustrative event potential

testCases.description: Tail consolidation involving single-source specialty items
testCases.expectedBehavior: Prevent consolidation where single-source or switching risk exceeds threshold
testCases.actualBehavior: Consolidation blocked for critical valves; dependency risk flag raised; dual-source mandated

testCases.description: Monopolistic utility tariff with zero price variance and fixed statutory pricing
testCases.expectedBehavior: Output "NO QUANTIFIABLE OPPORTUNITY IDENTIFIED FROM AVAILABLE HISTORICAL DATA" with reasons
testCases.actualBehavior: Properly labeled; zero manufactured savings; documented as regulated monopoly pricing

testCases.description: Module 3 PCBI market index reference applied alongside Module 2 opportunity into Module 4
testCases.expectedBehavior: PCBI benchmark displayed as external reference only; Module 4 consumes approved opportunity
testCases.actualBehavior: PCBI index isolated with zero customer price overwrite; approved package handed off to Module 4
